citation.authors: Eisenbach C, Pohl J, Dikow R, Stremmel W

cited_by.title: Sauna and heat bathing: heart health, recovery and risks

record.population: One 29-year-old African American with sickle cell trait
record.finding: A sauna visit triggered severe rhabdomyolysis (muscle breakdown) and acute kidney failure.
record.note: One case. It cannot say how often this happens; it is the reason sickle cell trait is flagged.
